features.description: Customers can pay in cash when the parcel arrives. The option appears at checkout and the order is confirmed without an online payment.
specRules: Cash on delivery can be chosen at checkout
The order is confirmed without an online payment
projectRules: Cash on delivery is not available above Rs 5000

features.description: Customers pay by entering a UPI id and approving the request in their UPI app. The order is placed after approval.
specRules: An approved request places the order
Payment uses a UPI id entered by the customer
projectRules: An unapproved UPI request expires after 5 minutes
The cart is kept when the request expires

features.description: A coupon box at checkout lets customers reduce the price of the order with a code.
specRules: A valid code reduces the order price
projectRules: A coupon needs a minimum order of Rs 500
Only one coupon can be used on an order

features.description: Customers fill in a form to return something they bought, choosing a reason and a pickup slot.
specRules: The customer chooses a return reason
The customer chooses a pickup slot
projectRules: Returns are allowed for 7 days after delivery
Groceries cannot be returned

features.description: A page shows customers where their refund is after a return.
specRules: The page shows the status of the refund
projectRules: Refunds go to the original payment method
Refunds complete within 5 working days

features.description: Customers manage their delivery addresses in their account: add, edit and delete.
specRules: An address can be added
An address can be edited
An address can be deleted
projectRules: A pincode must have exactly 6 digits
An account can save at most 5 addresses

features.description: A box on the product page tells customers whether the product can be delivered to them.
specRules: The customer enters a location on the product page and sees whether delivery is possible
projectRules: A pincode must have exactly 6 digits
An unserved pincode shows that delivery is not available

features.description: Suggestions appear under the search box while the customer types, and choosing one opens its results.
specRules: Suggestions appear while typing
Choosing a suggestion opens its results
projectRules: Search needs at least 2 characters

features.description: Long search results are split across pages with next and previous buttons.
specRules: Next and previous buttons move between pages
projectRules: A page shows 20 results
No results shows suggested popular categories

features.description: Plus and minus buttons in the cart change how many units of an item the customer buys.
specRules: The plus button adds a unit
The minus button removes a unit
projectRules: A cart holds at most 10 units of an item

features.description: The cart stays when a customer leaves the site and comes back later.
specRules: Cart items are still there on a later visit
projectRules: Carts are kept for 7 days
An item out of stock on return is flagged and blocks checkout

features.description: Customers sign in with a code sent to their phone.
specRules: A correct code signs the customer in
projectRules: The code has 6 digits
The code expires after 5 minutes
Three wrong codes lock sign in for 15 minutes

features.description: Customers stay signed in while using the site so they do not have to enter a code each time.
specRules: A customer in active use stays signed in
projectRules: A session ends after 30 idle minutes

features.description: Customers rate a product with stars and write about it.
specRules: A customer can give a star rating
A customer can write review text
projectRules: Only customers who received the product can review it
A review can have at most 500 characters

features.description: Customers save products for later and view them on a page.
specRules: A product can be saved for later
Saved products are listed on a page
projectRules: A wishlist holds at most 50 products
Moving an item to the cart removes it from the wishlist

features.description: Customers get text messages about their order.
specRules: Customers get a text message about the order
projectRules: The order SMS includes the order number
The order SMS is sent within 1 minute

features.description: Customers can download a bill for an order from the order page.
specRules: A bill can be downloaded from the order page
projectRules: The invoice shows the GST number and tax amount
The invoice is not available before delivery

features.description: Customers can cancel an order from the order page.
specRules: An order can be cancelled from the order page
projectRules: Cancel is not available after the order ships
Cancelling starts the refund

features.description: Checkout shows the delivery fee for the order and adds it to the total.
specRules: The delivery fee is added to the total
projectRules: Delivery is free from Rs 1000
An order of Rs 999 is charged the fee

features.description: A button on past orders adds the same items to the cart again.
specRules: The button adds the same items to the cart
projectRules: The cart limit of 10 units of an item still applies
An item out of stock is flagged
